Types and Styles of Women's Dresses

An iconic silhouette, essential to any collection. Discover our varied range of women's dresses from minimalist inspired choices to statement logo looks and everything in between. Search for casual dresses, formal dresses, women’s short sleeve dresses and more at the official Calvin Klein online store.

If you’re wondering about what styles of women’s dresses to search for at CalvinKlein.com, consider the types of women’s dresses that will best suit your wardrobe. Women’s dresses are highly subjective and when shopping, think about the dress materials, the dress fits, the dress sizes, the dress designs, the dress fabrics and what appeals best. Even elements like dress necklines, dress lengths, and dress silhouettes can impact dress styling. Stand out with a classic logo print t-shirt dress and sleeveless dresses on bright, beach-going days. Channel an effortless vibe with a flowing sundress, denim shirt dress or sweatshirt dress styles for when the temperatures drop.

Whether you’re searching for women’s formal dresses, bridesmaid dresses, casual dresses, work dresses, vacation dresses or holiday dresses, our full assortment features options for a wide range of occasions. Elevate your styling with a retro-inspired jumpsuit, a timeless women's slip dress or a work-ready sheath dress. For cocktail parties and special occasions, browse our assortment of women's bodycon dresses, fit + flare dresses, women’s cotton dresses, and more that easily transition from day to night. Thoughtfully created in mini, midi or maxi dresses silhouettes, our designer dresswear collection offers options for everybody. Accessorize flowing maxi dresses with jewelry and sandals. Style refined midi dresses with pumps and a signature watch for the perfect dress accessories. Add a knit sweater to mini dresses for a chic, layered look.

Search for additional style inspiration with our women's apparel collection. Add that finishing touch with styles from women's accessories. Start your outfit with a supportive foundation from our women's shapewear shop.
